results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the abstract operational flow, state transitions, and invariants of the runtime pipeline (e.g., Commit -> Replay -> Validation). Doc B provides a concrete semantic mapping, equating these abstract concepts to specific Delta3 Kernel entities and storage primitives (e.g., Event=WAL_Entry, Validation=Δ0_Validator).
results.integration_rationale: Doc A focuses on behavioral logic and pipeline orchestration, while Doc B serves as a semantic bridge linking abstract IR concepts to concrete Delta3 Kernel implementations. Keeping them separate maintains separation of concerns: Doc A remains focused on execution flow invariants, while Doc B acts as a reusable glossary/mapping layer that can be referenced by other system components (e.g., fault handling, session management) beyond just the runtime pipeline.
